notes.title: Glowpop Beta Testing
notes.notes:
We appreciate all players who have already taken the time and effort to provide feedback and tested the game!

Now it is time to start Beta Testing and we invite YOU to take part. Testing will be happening 5.8.2024-18.8.2024

Let us know you want to become a Beta Tester by 4.8.2024 10PM.
Submit your email via this form: [url=https://forms.gle/Uzvcs7o9FzzE3x6S6]Submit your contact.[/url]
We will provide you:
- Steam Key Code
- Instructions for testing
- Link to a feedback form

Those who have already purchased Early Access version will get the Beta Version automatically. The link to the feedback form will be also posted to our Steam page once Beta Testing begins. :)

Thank you for your support and don't forget to join our discord community!
[url=https://discord.gg/Jp6kWtPgna]Punnu Games Discord[/url]

Yours truly,
Punnu Games team

notes.title: Patch 0.8.4 LIVE!
notes.notes:
New features:

- You now have 5 save slots to utilize so you don't have to worry about losing your progression on other difficulties if you'd like to try out the other ones.
- Player statistics are now operational. You can check them out on the Bridge or in level selection.
- Planet 2 story is now fully accessable in POSTbox interactions.
- We also added a few easter eggs to Planet 2 levels.

Bug fixes and tweaks:

- Giant MeatEater should be stable now and rolling boulders behave as intended.
- Blinking Skip-button in intro-cinematic is blinking no more.
- We adjusted the light pickups so that they give you more light than they used to.

We're working hard on bringing you the next planet and we estimate that it will be published on 12.4.2024. We probably won't be pushing any updates before that unless a critical bug is found within the existing content.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.2 LIVE!
notes.notes:
New Content:

notes.title: Patch 0.8.1 LIVE!
notes.notes:
[b]New Features:[/b]

- Added a button when the last POSTbox is placed and story text is displayed to allow players to read it at their own pace before moving on to Victory screen.
- Planet 2 now has story texts, animations will be added later
- Planet 2 Level 5 got some visual updates

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

- Fixed the issue where difficulty selection jumped over Hard when navigating down with controller
- Planet 1 Level 3: Fixed the issue where game breaks when jumping into Boss. Special thanks to Twitch-streamer adeeduhs for finding this one!
- Planet 1 Level 3: Fixed the issue where boulders were not respawning after player died on Hard difficulty
- Planet 1 Level 3: Adjusted level navigation
- Planet 2 Level 3: Removed some invisible objects
- Planet 2 Level 3: disabled player movement during the Boss trigger activations
- Planet 2 Level 3: Blocked an area under the Boss to prevent soft locking players

notes.title: Glowpop Released to Early Access
notes.notes:
Uncover the Colorful Rainbow Glitter Splatter and discover hidden secrets and unravel the mystery behind Green Punnu's disappearance!
But beware, as danger lurks around every corner. From treacherous spikes to corrosive acid, players must utilize their wits and reflexes to overcome the challenges that stand in their way. 

In the Early Access release there are 10 maps on 2 different worlds with diverse hazards and some BIG BOSSES! Introducing ~2-3 hours of gameplay Punnu Games wants to include players to the final development phase as we are bringing more content to the game.

Are you ready to take the role of a little Yellow Punnu and show what your parkouring skills are made of?
Let's light up the galaxy together!

Want to give your support, report bugs or just be there for the Punnu Team? [url=https://discord.gg/R4qE9xbD4z][b]Join our discord![/b][/url]
